reuse.why: Routes moving through the existing applyWeekendRule/WeekendRule and adds a shared isHoliday, but the new daily-skip and range code re-implement the holiday test with config.holidays?.includes instead of isHoliday and do not reuse getUpcomingDates' pipeline.

duplication.why: The daily weekend/holiday skip filter is written four times (twice in getNextDate, in getUpcomingDates and in getDatesInRange), and getDatesInRange copies getUpcomingDates' occurrences-filter-map-captureBreadcrumb pipeline.

placement.why: Holiday moving sits in the shared applyWeekendRule in shared/schedules.ts, but the daily-skip rule is decided at each caller in server/schedules/app.ts and getNextDate rather than in the shared weekend-rule definition.

scope.why: Changes are on topic across the four steps; the import reorder in app.ts is a minor unrelated edit.

maintainability.why: The skip rule is scattered and already drifting (the app.ts copies ignore MM-DD holidays), so the next rule change would need four coordinated edits.

bypasses_abstraction.where: server/schedules/app.ts getUpcomingDates and getDatesInRange inline their own daily weekend/holiday filter with holidays?.includes instead of the shared isHoliday/applyWeekendRule; getNextDate turns the rule off with !isDaily and filters inline

disguised_duplication.where: the daily skip predicate appears as isHoliday-based filter in getNextDate (twice) and reshaped as config.frequency !== 'daily' || !skipWeekend || (!isWeekend && !holidays?.includes(...)) in getUpcomingDates and getDatesInRange

abstraction_drift.where: WeekendRule gains holidays and applyWeekendRule becomes a holiday-aware stepping loop (no longer using getDateWithSkippedWeekend); daily skipping stays outside it: getNextDate passes skipWeekend && !isDaily plus inline filters, and getUpcomingDates and getDatesInRange each re-implement the daily skip filter
